response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer, but the profile fundamentally mismatches this role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, no embedded networking or LAN-switch background, and no exposure to the required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection). C experience is limited to a brief stint years ago; the career trajectory centers on TypeScript/Node.js web platforms.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software engineering experience (15+ years) across web, mobile, and some systems work
Some low-level/systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, Linux)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — role requires native-level Japanese
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel modification, or LAN-switch/networking-protocol experience
No security-domain experience (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption/key exchange, tamper detection)
